inventorysortify.button.deposit_all: Move items to the container (except filtered ones)
inventorysortify.button.deposit_matching: Move items the container already has (except filtered ones)
inventorysortify.button.take_matching: Take items you already have in your inventory
inventorysortify.button.filter: Filter: items that stay in the inventory
inventorysortify.filter.title: Inventory filter
inventorysortify.filter.hint_items: Click the items that should stay in your inventory, wherever they are, when moving items to a chest.
inventorysortify.filter.hint_slots: Click the slots whose contents should stay in your inventory, even if other slots hold the same item.
inventorysortify.filter.slot_kept: This slot stays in the inventory
inventorysortify.filter.slot_not_kept: Click to keep this slot in the inventory
inventorysortify.filter.kept_by_item: Also kept by the item filter
inventorysortify.filter.not_kept: Click to keep it in the inventory
inventorysortify.message.server_missing: Sorting needs Inventory Sortify on the server too
inventorysortify.message.tool_protected: %s is about to break! Moved it to your inventory.
inventorysortify.message.tool_warning: %s is about to break! No empty slot to put it away.
inventorysortify.configuration.title: Inventory Sortify
inventorysortify.configuration.middleCli: Middle-click a slot to sort its inventory or container (not in creative mode).
inventorysortify.configuration.sortButto: Show small sort buttons above inventories and chests.
inventorysortify.configuration.filterMar: Mark inventory slots kept by the inventory filter with a small star.
inventorysortify.configuration.depositOn: ON: the up arrow only moves items the chest already has. OFF: it moves everything. Filtered items always stay.
inventorysortify.configuration.takeOnlyM: ON: the down arrow only takes items you already have in your inventory. OFF: it takes everything.
inventorysortify.configuration.autoRefil: Replace broken tools and used-up stacks in your hands from your inventory.
inventorysortify.configuration.refillBef: Swap a tool out just before it breaks, so it can still be repaired. With no spare tool, it is moved to an empty slot with a warning.
inventorysortify.configuration.refillDur: With "Refill before breaking" on, a tool is swapped for another one when its durability drops to this value, so it can still be repaired.
inventorysortify.configuration.sounds.to: Play a sound when sorting or refilling.
